highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 and a native GTK4 GPU canvas.
highlights_body: Linux NoDependencies font discovery is restored. WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and the Tizen packages now require Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64.

breaking.title: GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now allocates full-resolution backing on high-density displays and reports physical CanvasSize and paint Info by default. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true for logical paint coordinates while retaining physical backing resolution; GTK input coordinates remain logical.

breaking.title: Tizen 10 is required
breaking.body: New Tizen native builds and packages support Tizen 10 on x64 and arm64 only; Tizen 8/9 and the old 32-bit paths are unsupported. Move applications to net10.0-tizen10.0. Source builds require the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2; device loading remains unvalidated.

bullets.detail: Advances the renderer without new managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 distinguishes the milestone package line while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.
SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns context lifetime; use QueueRender to invalidate and include libepoxy when bundling a GTK runtime.

bullets.lead: Linux NoDependencies discovers installed fonts again
bullets.detail: Restores the directory-backed default font manager without adding fontconfig. The default scan uses /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at build time; a fontless directory retains the existing empty-family fallback.

bullets.lead: GTK4 raster storage released in ownership order
bullets.detail: Releases the Skia surface before Cairo-owned pixels and marks pixels dirty after channel swizzling.
SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 for net11+, retaining 3.1.34 for net8 and 3.1.56 for net9/net10.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored directory-backed font discovery in Linux NoDependencies native assets

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and Tizen 10 packages.

harfbuzz_summary: Aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly assets with Emscripten 6.0.2 and moves Tizen native packages to Tizen 10 on x64/arm64. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0; .100 is a package revision bucket.
